intro: Offline mods for Elden Ring, loaded with me3. Never use mods online in normal matchmaking: Easy Anti-Cheat can flag you. Seamless Co-op uses its own separate servers. Mod pages don't list a formal requirement for the loader; their install notes say to use Mod Engine 2 or me3.

mods.name: Seamless Co-op
mods.summary: Play the whole game with friends without the usual co-op limits, on separate servers.
mods.note: Uses its own launcher and save files; don't mix with normal online play.

mods.name: me3 (mod loader)
mods.summary: Loads file and DLL mods without touching your game files; successor to Mod Engine 2.
mods.note: Mods packaged for Mod Engine 2 also load with me3; follow each mod's install notes.

mods.name: Boss Arena
mods.summary: Adds a boss-selection menu at Roundtable Hold so you can refight any base-game or DLC boss.

mods.name: Map for Goblins
mods.summary: Marks loot and collectible items on the in-game map.

mods.name: Transmogrify Armor
mods.summary: Change your armor's look while keeping its stats.

mods.name: Glorious Merchant
mods.summary: A merchant who sells nearly every item, for testing builds.

mods.name: Item and Enemy Randomizer
mods.summary: Shuffles items and enemies for a fresh playthrough.

mods.name: Clever's Moveset Modpack
mods.summary: New weapon movesets and combat options.

mods.name: ELDEN RING Reforged (ERR)
mods.summary: Rebalance and expansion of the whole game; start a new character.

mods.name: The Convergence
mods.summary: Total overhaul with new classes, spells and bosses; start a new character.
